recentItems.title: [STRANGER THAN HEAVEN] World’s First Live Hands-On Combat Gameplay Stream! [RGG Studio TV #52]
recentItems.description:
This broadcast is a test stream with English subtitles, and some content may differ from the original.

RGG Studio’s latest title, STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
Hands-on gameplay of the combat system will be streamed live!
 
Playing the combat demo is Anju Inami, who was the Japanese voice of Chitose Fujinomiya in Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth, and is also a fan of the Yakuza & Like a Dragon series. As the first live gameplay, she will take on the challenge of mastering STRANGER THAN HEAVEN's controls, which differ from those of the Yakuza & Like a Dragon series.
 
Stream Date:
July 23, 2026 20:00 (JST) | July 23, 2026 04:00 PDT
 
 
In the stream:
Anju Inami (Japanese voice of Chitose Fujinomiya in Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth)
 
Masayoshi Yokoyama, Head of RGG Studio / Executive Director of STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
Hiroyuki Sakamoto, STRANGER THAN HEAVEN Producer 
and more!
 
MC:
Ayano Moriyama, Promotion Lead
 
 
Gameplay shown is from an early, in-development build and may differ from the final product.
